reusedFullCheck.note: Previously passed log reused, no full workspace or Desktop suite rerun; source hashes in test entries are current audit snapshots.

coverage.limit: Pure signed frontier only; generic port may not retry. Not historical response replay.

unavailable.reason: No real mail/calendar/git/CI account or account-token revocation exercised; all source adapters/providers in this audit are explicit fixtures.
No microphone, speaker, native banner, powered-off/resumed machine or real device resource release exercised.
NotificationHost requires a trusted verifier. The new persisted final-ledger verifier is a test fixture; no production ASR-final revision-to-settings bridge is proved.
Root owns real model/GPU acceptance. Fake Laya/DeepSeek decisions do not validate model quality or service availability.
Availability snapshots do not prove a cloud persistent host exists or that work continues 24/7 while the local computer is off.
